+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.MeasurementCompression
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.IdealPauli
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Observables.Defs
+
+/-!
+# Compression in Pauli soundness
+
+The genuine Naimark dilation preserves the prepared state and compresses to
+the original effects, including the answer postprocessing of the Pauli test.
+Composing local witness isometries therefore inserts two range projections.
+
+## References
+
+Formalization support for paper `thm:pauli`,
+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`,
+and the final transfer at `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1862-1876`.
+The distinction from ancilla intertwining is recorded in
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex` and issue #529.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity DistanceCalculus
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {P : AdmissibleParams}
+
+/-- The two local Naimark dilations of the supplied strategy. -/
+def pauliNaimarkStrategy (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
+    Strategy (pauliBasisTest P) :=
+  paddedStrategy S none none
+    (fun x => dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.A x))
+    (fun y => dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.B y))
+
+/-- The constructed dilation is projective on both local spaces. -/
+theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_projective (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
+    (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).IsProjective :=
+  paddedStrategy_isProjective S none none _ _
+    (fun x => dilatedMeasurement_isProjective (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.A x))
+    (fun y => dilatedMeasurement_isProjective (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.B y))
+
+/-- The supplied strategy and its dilation have exactly the same game value. -/
+theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_value (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
+    (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).value = S.value :=
+  paddedStrategy_value S none none _ _
+    (fun x a => dilatedMeasurement_compression (default : PauliAnswer P) a (S.A x))
+    (fun y b => dilatedMeasurement_compression (default : PauliAnswer P) b (S.B y))
+
+/-- The concrete projective setting produced from a supplied successful strategy.
+Both projectivity and its winning premise follow from the proved dilation. -/
+def pauliNaimarkSetting (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (hwin : 1 - epsilon ≤ S.value) : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon where
+  toStrategy := pauliNaimarkStrategy S
+  isProjective := pauliNaimarkStrategy_projective S
+  win := hwin.trans_eq (pauliNaimarkStrategy_value S).symm
+
+/-- Both ground embeddings prepare the actual dilated state exactly. -/
+theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_state (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
+    isometryTensor (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerA)
+      (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerB) S.ψ =
+        (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).ψ := by
+  ext p
+  change naimarkDilatedState (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerA S.ψ p = _
+  rw [naimarkDilatedState_apply]
+  simp only [pauliNaimarkStrategy, paddedStrategy, padState, ite_and]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Alice's actual Pauli readout compresses to the original postprocessed POVM. -/
+theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_alice
+    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    naimarkCompression
+      ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
+        pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
+      (((S.A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) := by
+  have hc := congrArg (fun M : Measurement (PauliRegister P) S.ιA => M.effect h)
+    ((dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P)
+      (S.A (pauliQuestion P W))).compressAt_postprocess
+      none pauliAnswerOrZero)
+  rw [Measurement.compressAt_dilatedMeasurement] at hc
+  exact hc
+
+/-- Bob's actual Pauli readout compresses to the original postprocessed POVM. -/
+theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_bob
+    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    naimarkCompression
+      ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
+        pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
+      (((S.B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) := by
+  have hc := congrArg (fun M : Measurement (PauliRegister P) S.ιB => M.effect h)
+    ((dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P)
+      (S.B (pauliQuestion P W))).compressAt_postprocess
+      none pauliAnswerOrZero)
+  rw [Measurement.compressAt_dilatedMeasurement] at hc
+  exact hc
+
+/-- Pull back the supplied witness isometries along the actual ground embeddings.
+The auxiliary state and both auxiliary spaces are preserved. -/
+def PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
+    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S)) :
+    PauliSoundnessWitness P S where
+  ιA' := w.ιA'
+  ιB' := w.ιB'
+  φA := w.φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerA)
+  φB := w.φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerB)
+  aux := w.aux
+  aux_norm := w.aux_norm
+
+/-- Pullback preserves the complete, unsquared state error exactly. -/
+theorem PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark_state_error
+    {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
+    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S)) :
+    ‖isometryTensor w.ofNaimark.φA w.ofNaimark.φB S.ψ -
+      idealState P w.ofNaimark.aux‖ =
+    ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ := by
+  dsimp only [PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark]
+  erw [isometryTensor_comp, pauliNaimarkStrategy_state]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Coordinate compression is precisely multiplication by the adjoint of the
+actual ground embedding on the left and by that embedding on the right. -/
+theorem naimarkCompression_eq_adjoint {ι α : Type}
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
+    (N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
+    naimarkCompression N =
+      (isometryMatrix (naimarkEmbedding ι α))ᴴ * N *
+        isometryMatrix (naimarkEmbedding ι α) := by
+  ext i j
+  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
+    isometryMatrix_apply, naimarkCompression_apply, eq_comm]
+
+/-- Compression followed by isometry conjugation inserts the ground projection
+on both sides; Naimark dilation supplies no intertwining identity. -/
+theorem conjIsometry_compressed {ι α κ : Type}
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
+    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
+    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ)
+    (N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
+    conjIsometry (φ.comp (naimarkEmbedding ι α)) (naimarkCompression N) =
+      conjIsometry φ (groundProjection ι α) * conjIsometry φ N *
+        conjIsometry φ (groundProjection ι α) := by
+  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression,
+    conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul]
+
+private theorem liftedAEffect_eq_tensor {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
+    {ιA' ιB' : Type} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
+    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
+    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × PauliRegister P))
+    (M : Op S.ιA) :
+    liftedAEffect S (ιB' := ιB') φ M = heteroKron (conjIsometry φ M) 1 := by
+  ext i j
+  simp [liftedAEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
+
+private theorem liftedBEffect_eq_tensor {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
+    {ιA' ιB' : Type} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
+    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
+    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × PauliRegister P))
+    (M : Op S.ιB) :
+    liftedBEffect S (ιA' := ιA') φ M = heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φ M) := by
+  ext i j
+  simp [liftedBEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
+
+/-- The original Alice readout is exactly `Q N Q` in the witness space. -/
+theorem PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark_compression_alice
+    {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
+    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S))
+    (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    liftedAEffect S (ιB' := w.ιB') w.ofNaimark.φA
+        (((S.A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
+      liftedAEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φA
+          (groundProjection S.ιA (PauliAnswer P)) *
+        liftedAEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φA
+          ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
+            pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) *
+        liftedAEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φA
+          (groundProjection S.ιA (PauliAnswer P)) := by
+  have hc := conjIsometry_compressed w.φA
+    ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
+      pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h)
+  rw [pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_alice] at hc
+  dsimp +instances only [PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark, pauliNaimarkStrategy,
+    paddedStrategy] at hc ⊢
+  have hh := congrArg (fun M => heteroKron M (1 : Op (w.ιB' × PauliRegister P))) hc
+  simp only [liftedAEffect_eq_tensor, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hh ⊢
+  exact hh
+
+/-- The original Bob readout is exactly `Q N Q` in the witness space. -/
+theorem PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark_compression_bob
+    {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
+    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S))
+    (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    liftedBEffect S (ιA' := w.ιA') w.ofNaimark.φB
+        (((S.B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
+      liftedBEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φB
+          (groundProjection S.ιB (PauliAnswer P)) *
+        liftedBEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φB
+          ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
+            pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) *
+        liftedBEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φB
+          (groundProjection S.ιB (PauliAnswer P)) := by
+  have hc := conjIsometry_compressed w.φB
+    ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
+      pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h)
+  rw [pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_bob] at hc
+  dsimp +instances only [PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark, pauliNaimarkStrategy,
+    paddedStrategy] at hc ⊢
+  have hh := congrArg (fun M => heteroKron (1 : Op (w.ιA' × PauliRegister P)) M) hc
+  simp only [liftedBEffect_eq_tensor, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hh ⊢
+  exact hh
+
+private theorem liftedA_sum_le {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.RangeProjection
+
+/-!
+# Ancilla isometries for Pauli soundness
+
+Adjoining a unit vector and applying a unitary gives the local isometry in the
+final soundness argument. The exact intertwining identity below supplies the
+algebraic hypothesis of the range-projection estimates. These results are
+recorded in blueprint `thm:pauli-ancilla-intertwining-support`.
+
+## References
+
+Formalization support for blueprint `thm:pauli`, specifically the isometry at
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1864-1875`.
+The registers are ordered as `AA'A''`, with the first two factors grouped.
+These constructions do not assume or construct a global polynomial measurement.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {ι κ ν : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+  [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν]
+
+/-- Adjoin a unit ancilla on the last two registers, in the extraction order
+`(AA')A''`. The norm condition is precisely the normalization of that ancilla. -/
+def ancillaBlockIsometry (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1) :
+    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ι × κ) × ν) where
+  toFun psi := reindexState (Equiv.prodAssoc ι κ ν).symm (vecTensor psi eta)
+  map_add' psi chi := by
+    ext p
+    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, add_mul]
+  map_smul' c psi := by
+    ext p
+    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, mul_assoc]
+  norm_map' psi := by
+    change ‖reindexState (Equiv.prodAssoc ι κ ν).symm (vecTensor psi eta)‖ = ‖psi‖
+    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq, heta, mul_one]
+
+/-- The columns of the ancilla isometry are the original basis vectors
+tensored with the fixed ancilla. -/
+theorem ancillaBlockIsometry_matrix_apply
+    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
+    (p : (ι × κ) × ν) (i : ι) :
+    isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) p i =
+      if p.1.1 = i then eta (p.1.2, p.2) else 0 := by
+  rw [isometryMatrix_apply]
+  simp [ancillaBlockIsometry, reindexState, vecTensor, eq_comm]
+
+/-- Extending an operator by identities commutes with adjoining a fixed ancilla.
+This exact identity is independent of any success or consistency estimate. -/
+theorem ancillaBlockIsometry_intertwines
+    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1) (M : Op ι) :
+    heteroKron (heteroKron M (1 : Op κ)) (1 : Op ν) *
+        isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) =
+      isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) * M := by
+  ext p i
+  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, ancillaBlockIsometry_matrix_apply, heteroKron,
+    Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_comm]
+
+/-- Apply a matrix isometry after adjoining the unit ancilla. In the source
+proof the matrix is the swap unitary and the ancilla is the local EPR state. -/
+def unitaryAncillaIsometry (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
+    (U : Op ((ι × κ) × ν)) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) :
+    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ι × κ) × ν) where
+  toLinearMap := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin U).comp
+    (ancillaBlockIsometry eta heta).toLinearMap
+  norm_map' psi := by
+    change ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin U (ancillaBlockIsometry eta heta psi)‖ = ‖psi‖
+    rw [norm_toEuclideanLin_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU, LinearIsometry.norm_map]
+
+/-- The matrix of the extraction isometry is the unitary times the ancilla
+embedding, with no range projection omitted. -/
+theorem unitaryAncillaIsometry_matrix
+    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
+    (U : Op ((ι × κ) × ν)) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) :
+    isometryMatrix (unitaryAncillaIsometry eta heta U hU) =
+      U * isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) := by
+  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
+  apply LinearMap.ext
+  intro psi
+  rw [toEuclideanLin_mul_apply]
+  simp only [isometryMatrix, Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The unitary conjugate of an extended operator intertwines with the
+extraction isometry. This proves the exact hypothesis needed by
+`sum_norm_leftTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le` and its Bob-side counterpart
+for the local isometries used in the final proof of `thm:pauli`. -/
+theorem unitaryAncillaIsometry_intertwines
+    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
+    (U : Op ((ι × κ) × ν)) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (M : Op ι) :
+    (U * heteroKron (heteroKron M (1 : Op κ)) (1 : Op ν) * Uᴴ) *
+        isometryMatrix (unitaryAncillaIsometry eta heta U hU) =
+      isometryMatrix (unitaryAncillaIsometry eta heta U hU) * M := by
+  rw [unitaryAncillaIsometry_matrix]
+  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
+  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U, hU, Matrix.one_mul,
+    ancillaBlockIsometry_intertwines]
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT
diff --git a/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/RangeProjection.lean b/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/RangeProjection.lean

+++ b/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/RangeProjection.lean
@@ -0,0 +1,216 @@
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.MagicSquareTheorems.Rigidity.GroundSlice
+
+/-!
+# Range projections in Pauli soundness
+
+Inserting an orthogonal projection into a measurement comparison costs at most
+twice the squared distance to a vector fixed by that projection. Summing over
+the measurement outcomes introduces no factor depending on their number.
+
+## References
+
+These are formalization-only auxiliary estimates for the final proof of
+blueprint `thm:pauli`. The range projection is omitted at
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1864-1875`;
+the corrected calculation is given in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`.
+They do not construct the extraction data or prove Pauli soundness.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+open DistanceCalculus MagicSquareRigidity
+
+/-- The identity conjugated by an isometry is its orthogonal range projection. -/
+private theorem conjIsometry_one_isProj {ι κ : Type}
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
+    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
+    IsProj (conjIsometry phi 1) := by
+  constructor
+  · change conjIsometry phi 1 * conjIsometry phi 1 = conjIsometry phi 1
+    rw [conjIsometry_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
+  · change star (conjIsometry phi 1) = conjIsometry phi 1
+    simp [conjIsometry_eq, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
+
+/-- Intertwining identifies isometry conjugation with insertion of its range projection. -/
+private theorem mul_conjIsometry_one_eq {ι κ : Type}
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
+    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) (M : Op ι) (N : Op κ)
+    (hintertwine : N * isometryMatrix phi = isometryMatrix phi * M) :
+    N * conjIsometry phi 1 = conjIsometry phi M := by
+  rw [conjIsometry_eq, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hintertwine]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Inserting a projection that fixes `theta` into a complete POVM costs at most
+twice the squared distance from the comparison state to `theta`, in addition
+to twice the original operator-family distance. This is blueprint
+`thm:pauli-range-projection-support`, the analytic range-projection estimate
+supporting `thm:pauli`. It holds for every complete POVM. -/
+theorem sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le {α ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (T : α → Op ι)
+    (Q : Op ι) (hQ : IsProj Q) (theta delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
+    (htheta : applyOperatorToState Q theta = theta) :
+    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * Q - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
+        2 * ‖delta - theta‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hvanish : applyOperatorToState (1 - Q) theta = 0 := by
+    have hfix : Matrix.toEuclideanLin Q theta = theta := htheta
+    simp [applyOperatorToState, hfix]
+  have hcomplement :
+      ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - Q) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖delta - theta‖ ^ 2 := by
+    have hnorm := norm_applyOperatorToState_le
+      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj hQ.one_sub) (delta - theta)
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, hvanish, sub_zero] at hnorm
+    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm 2
+  have hsum := sum_norm_mul_apply_le N.effect (1 - Q) delta
+    (MIPStarRE.QPBT.measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one N)
+  calc
+    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * Q - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
+        ∑ a : α, (2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 +
+          2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta‖ ^ 2) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro a _
+      have hsplit : N.effect a * Q - T a =
+          (N.effect a - T a) - N.effect a * (1 - Q) := by
+        rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
+        abel
+      have hsplit_action : applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * Q - T a) delta =
+          applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta -
+            applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta := by
+        rw [hsplit]
+        simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
+      rw [hsplit_action]
+      have hpar := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℂ
+        (applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta)
+        (applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta)
+      exact (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg
+        ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta +
+          applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta‖)).trans_eq
+        (hpar.trans (mul_add 2 _ _))
+    _ = 2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
+        2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta‖ ^ 2) := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
+    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
+      (hsum.trans hcomplement) (by norm_num))
+
+/-- The range-projection estimate for an isometry intertwining an operator
+family with a complete POVM, as in blueprint `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-support`.
+The intertwining identity is an exact operator
+identity, as obtained by adjoining a fixed ancilla and then conjugating by a
+unitary in the final proof of blueprint `thm:pauli`. No state or operator
+closeness is assumed: both errors appear explicitly on the right-hand side. -/
+theorem sum_norm_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le {α ι κ : Type}
+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
+    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ)
+    (M : α → Op ι) (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α κ) (T : α → Op κ)
+    (hintertwine : ∀ a : α,
+      N.effect a * isometryMatrix phi = isometryMatrix phi * M a)
+    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
+    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (conjIsometry phi (M a) - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
+        2 * ‖delta - phi psi‖ ^ 2 := by
+  let Q : Op κ := conjIsometry phi 1
+  have hQ : IsProj Q := conjIsometry_one_isProj phi
+  have hmatrix : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix phi) = phi.toLinearMap :=
+    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply phi.toLinearMap
+  have hfix : applyOperatorToState Q (phi psi) = phi psi := by
+    change Matrix.toEuclideanLin (conjIsometry phi 1) (phi.toLinearMap psi) =
+      phi.toLinearMap psi
+    rw [conjIsometry_eq, Matrix.mul_one, ← hmatrix, ← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply,
+      Matrix.mul_assoc, isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
+  have hcompression (a : α) : N.effect a * Q = conjIsometry phi (M a) :=
+    mul_conjIsometry_one_eq phi (M a) (N.effect a) (hintertwine a)
+  simpa only [hcompression] using
+    sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le N T Q hQ (phi psi) delta hfix
+
+/-- Alice's isometry transfer on a bipartite comparison state. The state error
+uses both local isometries, while each effect is conjugated only by Alice's
+isometry, as required by blueprint `thm:pauli`. The exact local intertwining
+identity is the one obtained from the ancilla extension and swap unitary.
+This is blueprint `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-alice-support`. -/
+theorem sum_norm_leftTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le {α ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
+    (phiA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (phiB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (M : α → Op ιA) (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α κA)
+    (T : α → Op (κA × κB))
+    (hintertwine : ∀ a : α,
+      N.effect a * isometryMatrix phiA = isometryMatrix phiA * M a)
+    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) :
+    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA (M a)) 1 - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (N.effect a) 1 - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
+        2 * ‖delta - isometryTensor phiA phiB psi‖ ^ 2 := by
+  let Q : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA 1) 1
+  have hQ : IsProj Q := by
+    constructor
+    · change Q * Q = Q
+      simp only [Q, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
+        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiA).isIdempotentElem.eq]
+    · change star Q = Q
+      simp only [Q, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
+        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
+        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiA).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
+  have hfix : applyOperatorToState Q (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) =
+      isometryTensor phiA phiB psi := by
+    dsimp only [Q]
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, heteroKron_one_one,
+      applyOperatorToState_one]
+  have hcompression (a : α) : (leftPlacedMeasurement N).effect a * Q =
+      heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA (M a)) 1 := by
+    change heteroKron (N.effect a) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA 1) 1 = _
+    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
+      mul_conjIsometry_one_eq phiA (M a) (N.effect a) (hintertwine a)]
+  have hbound := sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le (leftPlacedMeasurement N) T Q hQ
+    (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) delta hfix
+  simp only [hcompression] at hbound
+  simpa only [leftPlacedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using hbound
+
+/-- Bob's isometry transfer on a bipartite comparison state, with the same
+state error and constants independent of the answer count as Alice's transfer.
+This is blueprint `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-bob-support`, the second
+operator comparison needed in the proof of `thm:pauli`. -/
+theorem sum_norm_rightTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le {α ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
+    (phiA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (phiB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (M : α → Op ιB) (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α κB)
+    (T : α → Op (κA × κB))
+    (hintertwine : ∀ a : α,
+      N.effect a * isometryMatrix phiB = isometryMatrix phiB * M a)
+    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) :
+    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB (M a)) - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (N.effect a) - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
+        2 * ‖delta - isometryTensor phiA phiB psi‖ ^ 2 := by
+  let Q : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB 1)
+  have hQ : IsProj Q := by
+    constructor
+    · change Q * Q = Q
+      simp only [Q, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
+        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiB).isIdempotentElem.eq]
+    · change star Q = Q
+      simp only [Q, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
+        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
+        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiB).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
+  have hfix : applyOperatorToState Q (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) =
+      isometryTensor phiA phiB psi := by
+    dsimp only [Q]
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, heteroKron_one_one,
+      applyOperatorToState_one]
+  have hcompression (a : α) : (rightPlacedMeasurement N).effect a * Q =
+      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB (M a)) := by
+    change heteroKron 1 (N.effect a) * heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB 1) = _
+    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
+      mul_conjIsometry_one_eq phiB (M a) (N.effect a) (hintertwine a)]
+  have hbound := sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le (rightPlacedMeasurement N) T Q hQ
+    (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) delta hfix
+  simp only [hcompression] at hbound
+  simpa only [rightPlacedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using hbound
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.MeasurementCompression
     2	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.IdealPauli
     3	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Observables.Defs
     4	
     5	/-!
     6	# Compression in Pauli soundness
     7	
     8	The genuine Naimark dilation preserves the prepared state and compresses to
     9	the original effects, including the answer postprocessing of the Pauli test.
    10	Composing local witness isometries therefore inserts two range projections.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	Formalization support for paper `thm:pauli`,
    15	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`,
    16	and the final transfer at `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1862-1876`.
    17	The distinction from ancilla intertwining is recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex` and issue #529.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity DistanceCalculus
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	variable {P : AdmissibleParams}
    30	
    31	/-- The two local Naimark dilations of the supplied strategy. -/
    32	def pauliNaimarkStrategy (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
    33	    Strategy (pauliBasisTest P) :=
    34	  paddedStrategy S none none
    35	    (fun x => dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.A x))
    36	    (fun y => dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.B y))
    37	
    38	/-- The constructed dilation is projective on both local spaces. -/
    39	theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_projective (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
    40	    (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).IsProjective :=
    41	  paddedStrategy_isProjective S none none _ _
    42	    (fun x => dilatedMeasurement_isProjective (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.A x))
    43	    (fun y => dilatedMeasurement_isProjective (default : PauliAnswer P) (S.B y))
    44	
    45	/-- The supplied strategy and its dilation have exactly the same game value. -/
    46	theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_value (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
    47	    (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).value = S.value :=
    48	  paddedStrategy_value S none none _ _
    49	    (fun x a => dilatedMeasurement_compression (default : PauliAnswer P) a (S.A x))
    50	    (fun y b => dilatedMeasurement_compression (default : PauliAnswer P) b (S.B y))
    51	
    52	/-- The concrete projective setting produced from a supplied successful strategy.
    53	Both projectivity and its winning premise follow from the proved dilation. -/
    54	def pauliNaimarkSetting (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) {epsilon : ℝ}
    55	    (hwin : 1 - epsilon ≤ S.value) : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon where
    56	  toStrategy := pauliNaimarkStrategy S
    57	  isProjective := pauliNaimarkStrategy_projective S
    58	  win := hwin.trans_eq (pauliNaimarkStrategy_value S).symm
    59	
    60	/-- Both ground embeddings prepare the actual dilated state exactly. -/
    61	theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_state (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) :
    62	    isometryTensor (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerA)
    63	      (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerB) S.ψ =
    64	        (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).ψ := by
    65	  ext p
    66	  change naimarkDilatedState (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerA S.ψ p = _
    67	  rw [naimarkDilatedState_apply]
    68	  simp only [pauliNaimarkStrategy, paddedStrategy, padState, ite_and]
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	/-- Alice's actual Pauli readout compresses to the original postprocessed POVM. -/
    72	theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_alice
    73	    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
    74	    naimarkCompression
    75	      ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
    76	        pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
    77	      (((S.A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) := by
    78	  have hc := congrArg (fun M : Measurement (PauliRegister P) S.ιA => M.effect h)
    79	    ((dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P)
    80	      (S.A (pauliQuestion P W))).compressAt_postprocess
    81	      none pauliAnswerOrZero)
    82	  rw [Measurement.compressAt_dilatedMeasurement] at hc
    83	  exact hc
    84	
    85	/-- Bob's actual Pauli readout compresses to the original postprocessed POVM. -/
    86	theorem pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_bob
    87	    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
    88	    naimarkCompression
    89	      ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
    90	        pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
    91	      (((S.B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) := by
    92	  have hc := congrArg (fun M : Measurement (PauliRegister P) S.ιB => M.effect h)
    93	    ((dilatedMeasurement (default : PauliAnswer P)
    94	      (S.B (pauliQuestion P W))).compressAt_postprocess
    95	      none pauliAnswerOrZero)
    96	  rw [Measurement.compressAt_dilatedMeasurement] at hc
    97	  exact hc
    98	
    99	/-- Pull back the supplied witness isometries along the actual ground embeddings.
   100	The auxiliary state and both auxiliary spaces are preserved. -/
   101	def PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
   102	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S)) :
   103	    PauliSoundnessWitness P S where
   104	  ιA' := w.ιA'
   105	  ιB' := w.ιB'
   106	  φA := w.φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerA)
   107	  φB := w.φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB (pauliBasisTest P).AnswerB)
   108	  aux := w.aux
   109	  aux_norm := w.aux_norm
   110	
   111	/-- Pullback preserves the complete, unsquared state error exactly. -/
   112	theorem PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark_state_error
   113	    {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
   114	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S)) :
   115	    ‖isometryTensor w.ofNaimark.φA w.ofNaimark.φB S.ψ -
   116	      idealState P w.ofNaimark.aux‖ =
   117	    ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB (pauliNaimarkStrategy S).ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ := by
   118	  dsimp only [PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark]
   119	  erw [isometryTensor_comp, pauliNaimarkStrategy_state]
   120	  rfl
   121	
   122	/-- Coordinate compression is precisely multiplication by the adjoint of the
   123	actual ground embedding on the left and by that embedding on the right. -/
   124	theorem naimarkCompression_eq_adjoint {ι α : Type}
   125	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   126	    (N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   127	    naimarkCompression N =
   128	      (isometryMatrix (naimarkEmbedding ι α))ᴴ * N *
   129	        isometryMatrix (naimarkEmbedding ι α) := by
   130	  ext i j
   131	  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
   132	    isometryMatrix_apply, naimarkCompression_apply, eq_comm]
   133	
   134	/-- Compression followed by isometry conjugation inserts the ground projection
   135	on both sides; Naimark dilation supplies no intertwining identity. -/
   136	theorem conjIsometry_compressed {ι α κ : Type}
   137	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   138	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
   139	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ)
   140	    (N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   141	    conjIsometry (φ.comp (naimarkEmbedding ι α)) (naimarkCompression N) =
   142	      conjIsometry φ (groundProjection ι α) * conjIsometry φ N *
   143	        conjIsometry φ (groundProjection ι α) := by
   144	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression,
   145	    conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul]
   146	
   147	private theorem liftedAEffect_eq_tensor {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   148	    {ιA' ιB' : Type} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   149	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
   150	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × PauliRegister P))
   151	    (M : Op S.ιA) :
   152	    liftedAEffect S (ιB' := ιB') φ M = heteroKron (conjIsometry φ M) 1 := by
   153	  ext i j
   154	  simp [liftedAEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
   155	
   156	private theorem liftedBEffect_eq_tensor {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   157	    {ιA' ιB' : Type} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   158	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
   159	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × PauliRegister P))
   160	    (M : Op S.ιB) :
   161	    liftedBEffect S (ιA' := ιA') φ M = heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φ M) := by
   162	  ext i j
   163	  simp [liftedBEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
   164	
   165	/-- The original Alice readout is exactly `Q N Q` in the witness space. -/
   166	theorem PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark_compression_alice
   167	    {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
   168	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S))
   169	    (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
   170	    liftedAEffect S (ιB' := w.ιB') w.ofNaimark.φA
   171	        (((S.A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) =
   172	      liftedAEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φA
   173	          (groundProjection S.ιA (PauliAnswer P)) *
   174	        liftedAEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φA
   175	          ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
   176	            pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) *
   177	        liftedAEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φA
   178	          (groundProjection S.ιA (PauliAnswer P)) := by
   179	  have hc := conjIsometry_compressed w.φA
   180	    ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
   181	      pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h)
   182	  rw [pauliNaimarkStrategy_compression_alice] at hc
   183	  dsimp +instances only [PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark, pauliNaimarkStrategy,
   184	    paddedStrategy] at hc ⊢
   185	  have hh := congrArg (fun M => heteroKron M (1 : Op (w.ιB' × PauliRegister P))) hc
   186	  simp only [liftedAEffect_eq_tensor, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at hh ⊢
   187	  exact hh

   189	/-- The original Bob readout is exactly `Q N Q` in the witness space. -/

   191	    {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
   192	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P (pauliNaimarkStrategy S))
   193	    (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :

   196	      liftedBEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φB

   198	        liftedBEffect (pauliNaimarkStrategy S) w.φB
   199	          ((((pauliNaimarkStrategy S).B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess
   200	            pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h) *

   202	          (groundProjection S.ιB (PauliAnswer P)) := by

   205	      pauliAnswerOrZero).effect h)

   207	  dsimp +instances only [PauliSoundnessWitness.ofNaimark, pauliNaimarkStrategy,

# Pauli soundness under genuine Naimark compression

## Result and scope

The actual, value-preserving Naimark dilation and return of supplied
soundness data to an arbitrary original strategy are proved. Both original
local spaces and measurement families remain independent. No projectivity,
symmetry, ideal-state range assumption, additional field assumption, or
outcome-count factor is imposed on the original strategy.

For a supplied witness on the concrete dilation, let `e` be its unsquared
state error and `dA`, `dB` its Pauli squared-sum errors at one basis. The
composed witness has exactly the same state error and satisfies

```text
original Alice distance <= 3 * dA + 6 * e^2
original Bob distance   <= 3 * dB + 6 * e^2
each original distance <= 4
```

Consequently, if all three supplied errors are at most `delta`, the state
error remains at most `delta` and both operator errors are at most
`9 * delta`, for every nonnegative `delta`. The small-error estimate is
`3 * delta + 6 * delta^2`; use it for `delta <= 1`, and use the absolute
bound four for `delta >= 1`. A common bound for all conclusions is
`9 * delta`. If the supplied bound is `deltaQld a b epsilon m d q`, with
`a >= 1` and `epsilon >= 0`, replacing `a` by `9 * a` absorbs this factor.
The exponent `b` is unchanged and no upper bound on `epsilon` is needed
for this scalar comparison.

These are conditional transfer theorems. The supplied data are precisely
the witness and its three error bounds for the actual dilation. They are
not new hypotheses of `pauli_soundness`.

    38	\section{Key theorem forms}
    39	
    40	Let $H_X$ and $H_Z$ be the positive contractions of the extraction proof, and
    41	let $\vartheta$ be a unit vector such that
    42	\[
    43	  \langle\vartheta,H_W\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta/2
    44	  \qquad (W\in\{X,Z\}).
    45	\]
    46	Since $(I-H_W)^2\geq0$,
    47	\[
    48	  H_W^2\geq2H_W-I,
    49	  \qquad
    50	  \langle\vartheta,H_W^2\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta.
    51	\]
    52	Also $\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert^2\leq\delta$, whence
    53	\[
    54	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert^2\leq4\delta.
    55	\]
    56	Together with $H_XH_Z$ equal to the EPR projection, these estimates give the
    57	required overlap bound, with constants absorbed into the stated
    58	$O(\sqrt\delta)$ error.
    59	
    60	For the final transfer, let $\phi\colon\mathcal H\to\mathcal K$ be an isometry
    61	and set $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$.  If $N_h$ is the unitary-conjugated extension of
    62	a measurement operator $M_h$, then the exact identity is
    63	\[
    64	  \phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ=QN_h,
    65	\]
    66	not merely $N_h$.  Thus comparison of $N_h$ with an ideal projector must be
    67	combined with control of $(I-Q)\Delta$ on the ideal comparison state
    68	$\Delta$.

   153	\section{Returning through a general Naimark dilation}
   154	
   155	The preceding ancilla argument must be distinguished from the dilation of an
   156	arbitrary original POVM. Let $J$ be its ground embedding and $P_h$ its dilated
   157	projectors. Naimark dilation gives $M_h=J^\dagger P_hJ$; it does not give
   158	$P_hJ=JM_h$. If $\phi$ is a supplied soundness isometry for the dilated
   159	strategy, set $Q=\phi JJ^\dagger\phi^\dagger$ and
   160	$N_h=\phi P_h\phi^\dagger$. The original conjugated effect is exactly
   161	$QN_hQ$. Summation over fibers shows that the same identity holds for the
   162	actual Pauli readouts after the game's answer postprocessing.
   163	
   164	Let $\theta$ be the transformed actual state and $\Delta$ the unit ideal
   165	auxiliary-state/EPR vector. Exact dilation preparation preserves the state
   166	error and gives $Q\theta=\theta$. The required decomposition is
   167	\[
   168	 (QN_hQ-T_h)\Delta
   169	 =Q(N_h-T_h)\Delta-QN_h(I-Q)\Delta-(I-Q)T_h\Delta.
   170	\]
   171	On an EPR vector, a matrix on one register equals its transpose acting on
   172	the other register. The opposite-register family therefore commutes with
   173	$Q$ and controls the final term by $\|(I-Q)\Delta\|^2$ after summing squares.
   174	The general complex-matrix transpose identity is proved explicitly. For the
   175	existing fixed-field Pauli API, its previously proved
   176	\path{pauliProj_transpose} identifies the transpose with the same Pauli
   177	label. This uses the existing model, not an additional field restriction or
   178	an assumption that arbitrary complex projectors are real.
   179	
   180	If the state norm error and dilated Pauli squared-sum error are at most
   181	$\delta$, the result is at most $3\delta+6\delta^2$. The families $N_h$
   182	are generally not complete on the witness space: their total is a range
   183	projection. Nevertheless isometry conjugation preserves
   184	$\sum_h N_h^\dagger N_h\le I$. Thus any two such contractions have
   185	squared distance at most four on a unit vector. The two estimates give the
   186	common operator bound $9\delta$ for every $\delta\ge0$, while the state
   187	norm error remains at most $\delta$. No ideal-state range assumption or
   188	outcome-count factor occurs.

   101	/-- Two-sided compression costs three times the original squared family error
   102	and six times the squared state error. The mirror relation is only on the
   103	comparison vector; no range assumption is imposed on that vector. -/
   104	theorem sum_norm_compression_sub_sq_le {α ι : Type*}
   105	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   106	    (N T R : α → Op ι) (Q : Op ι) (hQ : IsProj Q)
   107	    (hN : ∑ a, (N a)ᴴ * N a ≤ 1) (hR : ∑ a, (R a)ᴴ * R a ≤ 1)
   108	    (theta delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   109	    (hfix : applyOperatorToState Q theta = theta)
   110	    (hmirror : ∀ a, applyOperatorToState (T a) delta = applyOperatorToState (R a) delta)
   111	    (hcomm : ∀ a, Q * R a = R a * Q) :
   112	    ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (Q * N a * Q - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
   113	      3 * (∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (N a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
   114	        6 * ‖delta - theta‖ ^ 2 := by
   115	  have hcontract (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   116	      ‖applyOperatorToState Q v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 :=
   117	    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
   118	      (norm_applyOperatorToState_le (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj hQ) v) 2
   119	  have hvanish : applyOperatorToState (1 - Q) theta = 0 := by
   120	    simp [applyOperatorToState, show Matrix.toEuclideanLin Q theta = theta from hfix]
   121	  have hrange : ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - Q) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖delta - theta‖ ^ 2 := by
   122	    have h := norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   123	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj hQ.one_sub) (delta - theta)
   124	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, hvanish, sub_zero] at h
   125	    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
   126	  have hn := (sum_norm_mul_apply_le N (1 - Q) delta hN).trans hrange
   127	  have hr := (sum_norm_mul_apply_le R (1 - Q) delta hR).trans hrange
   128	  have hpoint (a : α) :
   129	      ‖applyOperatorToState (Q * N a * Q - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
   130	        3 * (‖applyOperatorToState (N a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 +
   131	          ‖applyOperatorToState (N a * (1 - Q)) delta‖ ^ 2 +
   132	          ‖applyOperatorToState (R a * (1 - Q)) delta‖ ^ 2) := by
   133	    have hs : Q * N a * Q - T a =
   134	        Q * (N a - T a) - Q * (N a * (1 - Q)) - (1 - Q) * T a := by
   135	      noncomm_ring
   136	    have hm : applyOperatorToState ((1 - Q) * T a) delta =
   137	        applyOperatorToState (R a * (1 - Q)) delta := by
   138	      rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, hmirror]
   139	      rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul]
   140	      congr 1
   141	      rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one, hcomm]
   142	    rw [hs]
   143	    rw [apply_sub_operator, apply_sub_operator]
   144	    rw [hm, applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_mul,
   145	      sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
   146	    have h := norm_add_three_sq_le
   147	      (applyOperatorToState Q (applyOperatorToState (N a - T a) delta))
   148	      (-applyOperatorToState Q (applyOperatorToState (N a * (1 - Q)) delta))
   149	      (-applyOperatorToState (R a * (1 - Q)) delta)
   150	    simp only [norm_neg] at h
   151	    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
   152	      (add_le_add (add_le_add (hcontract _) (hcontract _)) le_rfl) (by norm_num))
   153	  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a (_ : a ∈ Finset.univ) => hpoint a)
   154	  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
   155	  nlinarith

    17	# Pauli soundness under genuine Naimark compression
    18	
    19	## Result and scope
    20	
    21	The actual, value-preserving Naimark dilation and return of supplied
    22	soundness data to an arbitrary original strategy are proved. Both original
    23	local spaces and measurement families remain independent. No projectivity,
    24	symmetry, ideal-state range assumption, additional field assumption, or
    25	outcome-count factor is imposed on the original strategy.
    26	
    27	For a supplied witness on the concrete dilation, let `e` be its unsquared
    28	state error and `dA`, `dB` its Pauli squared-sum errors at one basis. The
    29	composed witness has exactly the same state error and satisfies
    30	
    31	```text
    32	original Alice distance <= 3 * dA + 6 * e^2
    33	original Bob distance   <= 3 * dB + 6 * e^2
    34	each original distance <= 4
    35	```
    36	
    37	Consequently, if all three supplied errors are at most `delta`, the state
    38	error remains at most `delta` and both operator errors are at most
    39	`9 * delta`, for every nonnegative `delta`. The small-error estimate is
    40	`3 * delta + 6 * delta^2`; use it for `delta <= 1`, and use the absolute
    41	bound four for `delta >= 1`. A common bound for all conclusions is
    42	`9 * delta`. If the supplied bound is `deltaQld a b epsilon m d q`, with
    43	`a >= 1` and `epsilon >= 0`, replacing `a` by `9 * a` absorbs this factor.

    45	for this scalar comparison.

    47	These are conditional transfer theorems. The supplied data are precisely
    48	the witness and its three error bounds for the actual dilation. They are
    49	not new hypotheses of `pauli_soundness`.

     4	/-!
     5	# Contractions, isometries and the ground slice of the dilation
     6	
     7	Support for the transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity` (blueprint
     8	`thm:ms-rigidity`, paper
     9	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`):
    10	the calculus needed to compare the dilated projective strategy of
    11	`Rigidity/Dilation.lean` with the original strategy on states.
    12	
    13	* Contractions: operators `K` with `Kᴴ K ≤ 1` do not increase norms; effects,
    14	  observables of binary measurements, orthogonal projections, tensor placements,
    15	  products and isometry conjugates are contractions.
    16	* Matrices of isometries: `Vᴴ V = 1`, the two-sided isometry image of a state
    17	  preserves norms, and a conjugated local operator acts on the transported state
    18	  as the original operator acts on the original state.
    19	* The ground projection `Π` of an enlarged local space: an orthogonal projection
    20	  fixing the dilated state, with `Π P Π` the inflation of the compression of `P`.
    21	* Leakage: the part `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of a dilated operator that leaves the ground
    22	  slice is bounded by the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any `1 ⊗ Q`,
    23	  because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `(1 ⊗ Q) ψ'`.  This is the estimate that
    24	  replaces the `≈_δ`-preservation which Naimark dilation lacks in general
    25	  (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`, blueprint
    26	  `ex:easy-but-long`).
    27	
    28	## References
    29	
    30	blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity`,
    31	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    32	-/

    46	theorem applyOperatorToState_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    48	    applyOperatorToState (1 : Op ι) v = v := by

    53	    (M : Op ι) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    54	    applyOperatorToState M (u + v) =
    55	      applyOperatorToState M u + applyOperatorToState M v := by
    56	  simp [applyOperatorToState]

    62	      applyOperatorToState M u - applyOperatorToState M v := by

    77	/-- Applying a product of rectangular matrices is successive application. -/
    78	theorem toEuclideanLin_mul_apply {m n o : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype o]
    79	    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq o]
    80	    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n o ℂ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ o) :
    81	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A * B) v =
    82	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B v) := by

    85	/-- The squared norm of `A v` is the quadratic form of `Aᴴ A` at `v`. -/
    86	theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_sq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    87	    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    88	    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v‖ ^ 2 =
    89	      (inner ℂ v (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Aᴴ * A) v)).re := by
    90	  rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ, Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self]
    91	  change (inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v)).re =
    92	    (inner ℂ v ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v))).re
    93	  rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

    95	/-- A rectangular matrix `A` with `Aᴴ A = 1` preserves norms. -/
    96	theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
    97	    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m n ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ * A = 1)
    98	    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    99	    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
   100	  have h := norm_toEuclideanLin_sq A v
   101	  have hv : (inner ℂ v v).re = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
   102	    simpa using inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) v
   103	  have hone : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) v = v := by
   104	    simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin]
   105	  rw [hA, hone, hv] at h
   106	  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).1 h

   108	/-- The squared norm of `K v` is the quadratic form of `Kᴴ K` at `v`. -/
   109	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   110	    (K : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   111	    ‖applyOperatorToState K v‖ ^ 2 =
   112	      (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState (Kᴴ * K) v)).re :=
   113	  norm_toEuclideanLin_sq K v

   115	/-- An operator `K` with `Kᴴ K ≤ 1` does not increase norms. -/
   116	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   117	    {K : Op ι} (hK : Kᴴ * K ≤ 1) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   118	    ‖applyOperatorToState K v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
   119	  have h := quadratic_form_mono hK v
   120	  have hv : (inner ℂ v v).re = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
   121	    simpa using inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) v
   122	  rw [← norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, applyOperatorToState_one, hv] at h
   123	  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).1 h
   124	
   125	/-- The difference of two contractions at most doubles norms. -/
   126	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   127	    {A B : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   128	    ‖applyOperatorToState (A - B) v‖ ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ := by
   129	  have hsplit : applyOperatorToState (A - B) v =
   130	      applyOperatorToState A v - applyOperatorToState B v := by
   131	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   132	  rw [hsplit]
   133	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState A v - applyOperatorToState B v‖ ≤
   134	        ‖applyOperatorToState A v‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState B v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
   135	    _ ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖v‖ := add_le_add (norm_applyOperatorToState_le hA v)
   136	        (norm_applyOperatorToState_le hB v)
   137	    _ = 2 * ‖v‖ := by ring

   139	/-- Orthogonal projections are contractions. -/
   140	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   141	    {P : Op ι} (hP : IsProj P) : Pᴴ * P ≤ 1 := by
   142	  have hstar : Pᴴ = P := by
   143	    rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
   144	    exact hP.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
   145	  rw [hstar, hP.isIdempotentElem.eq]
   146	  exact sub_nonneg.mp hP.one_sub.nonneg

   148	/-- Products of contractions are contractions. -/
   149	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   150	    {A B : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) :
   151	    (A * B)ᴴ * (A * B) ≤ 1 := by
   152	  have h1 : (1 - Aᴴ * A).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hA
   153	  have h2 := h1.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
   154	  have h3 : Bᴴ * (1 - Aᴴ * A) * B = Bᴴ * B - (A * B)ᴴ * (A * B) := by
   155	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   156	    noncomm_ring
   157	  refine le_trans ?_ hB
   158	  rw [Matrix.le_iff, ← h3]
   159	  exact h2

   161	/-- Effects of a measurement are contractions. -/
   162	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
   163	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (a : α) :
   164	    (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
   165	  rw [measurement_effect_hermitian]
   166	  exact le_trans (sq_le_self (M.pos a) (measurement_effect_le_one M a))
   167	    (measurement_effect_le_one M a)

   169	/-- The observable of a binary measurement is a contraction: writing
   170	`E = M_0`, the observable is `2E - 1` and `1 - (2E - 1)² = 4(E - E²) ≥ 0`. -/
   171	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_obsOf {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   172	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) ι) :
   173	    (obsOf M)ᴴ * obsOf M ≤ 1 := by
   174	  have hsum : M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 = 1 := by
   175	    have h : ∑ a : Fin 2, M.effect a = 1 := M.sum_eq_one
   176	    rwa [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
   177	  have hobs : obsOf M = M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1 := by
   178	    unfold obsOf
   179	    rw [← hsum]
   180	    abel
   181	  have hH : (M.effect 0)ᴴ = M.effect 0 := measurement_effect_hermitian M 0
   182	  have hsq : 0 ≤ M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 0 :=
   183	    sub_nonneg.mpr (sq_le_self (M.pos 0) (measurement_effect_le_one M 0))
   184	  rw [hobs]
   185	  have hid : (M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1)ᴴ * (M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1) =
   186	      1 - (4 : ℕ) • (M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 0) := by
   187	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
   188	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hH]
   189	    noncomm_ring
   190	  rw [hid]
   191	  exact sub_le_self _ (nsmul_nonneg hsq 4)

   245	/-- The matrix of an isometry is a matrix isometry. -/
   246	theorem isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   247	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   248	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   249	    (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ = 1 := by
   250	  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
   251	  have hM : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) = φ.toLinearMap :=
   252	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply φ.toLinearMap
   253	  calc
   254	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ) =
   255	        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)).adjoint.comp
   256	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)) :=
   257	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self _
   258	    _ = φ.toLinearMap.adjoint.comp φ.toLinearMap := by rw [hM]
   259	    _ = 1 := φ.adjoint_comp_self'
   260	    _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
   261	      rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]
   262	      rfl

   264	/-- The range projection `V Vᴴ` of a matrix isometry is at most the identity. -/
   265	theorem isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   266	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   267	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   268	    isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤ 1 := by
   269	  have hproj : IsProj (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) := by
   270	    constructor
   271	    · change (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) *
   272	        (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   273	      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ,
   274	        isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   275	    · change star (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   276	        isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   277	      simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   278	  exact sub_nonneg.mp hproj.one_sub.nonneg

   280	/-- Conjugation by an isometry preserves contractions. -/
   281	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   282	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   283	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') {A : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) :
   284	    (conjIsometry φ A)ᴴ * conjIsometry φ A ≤ 1 := by
   285	  rw [conjIsometry_eq]
   286	  have h1 : (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ)ᴴ *
   287	      (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   288	      isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   289	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
   290	      Matrix.mul_assoc]
   291	    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ (isometryMatrix φ),
   292	      isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   293	  rw [h1]
   294	  calc isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤
   295	        isometryMatrix φ * (1 : Op ι) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   296	        rw [Matrix.le_iff]
   297	        have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (isometryMatrix φ)
   298	        convert h using 1
   299	        simp [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
   300	    _ = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_one]
   301	    _ ≤ 1 := isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one φ

   319	/-- The two-sided isometry image of a state is the action of the Kronecker
   320	product of the two isometry matrices. -/
   321	theorem isometryTensor_eq_toEuclideanLin {ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
   322	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   323	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   324	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   325	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   326	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   327	    isometryTensor φA φB ψ =
   328	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin
   329	        (Matrix.kronecker (isometryMatrix φA) (isometryMatrix φB)) ψ := by

   332	  simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

   397	/-! ## The ground projection -/

   399	/-- The orthogonal projection of an enlarged local space onto its ground slice,
   400	namely the inflation of the identity.  Formalization-only support for the
   401	transfer step of blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity`. -/
   402	def groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   403	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   404	  naimarkInflation (α := α) (1 : Op ι)

   406	/-- Inflation is multiplicative. -/
   407	theorem naimarkInflation_mul {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   408	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
   409	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M * naimarkInflation (α := α) N =
   410	      naimarkInflation (α := α) (M * N) := by
   411	  ext p q
   412	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
   413	    Fintype.sum_option]
   414	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   415	
   416	/-- Inflation commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   417	theorem naimarkInflation_conjTranspose {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   418	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   419	    (naimarkInflation (α := α) M)ᴴ = naimarkInflation (α := α) Mᴴ := by
   420	  ext p q
   421	  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, naimarkInflation_apply]
   422	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]

   425	theorem isProj_groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   426	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : IsProj (groundProjection ι α) := by
   427	  constructor
   428	  · change groundProjection ι α * groundProjection ι α = groundProjection ι α
   429	    rw [groundProjection, naimarkInflation_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
   430	  · change star (groundProjection ι α) = groundProjection ι α

    32	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`.

    39	/-- The binary character used for generalized Pauli phases; see
    40	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1081`.
    41	
    42	It is public because the Fourier expansion declarations below expose this
    43	character in their statement types. -/
    44	noncomputable def phaseSign (t : ZMod 2) : ℂ :=
    45	  if t = 0 then 1 else -1

    47	/-- Formalization-only expansion of a sum over the binary field into its two
    48	terms. -/
    49	theorem sum_zmod_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ZMod 2 → M) :
    50	    ∑ b, f b = f 0 + f 1 := by
    51	  calc
    52	    ∑ b, f b = ∑ i : Fin 2, f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 i) := by
    53	      exact Fintype.sum_equiv (ZMod.finEquiv 2).symm f
    54	        (fun i : Fin 2 => f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 i)) (fun _ => rfl)
    55	    _ = f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 0) + f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 1) := Fin.sum_univ_two _
    56	    _ = f 0 + f 1 := by rfl
    57	
    58	/-- Formalization-only case split for the binary field: every element is zero
    59	or one. -/
    60	theorem zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (b : ZMod 2) : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by
    61	  by_cases hb : b = 0
    62	  · exact Or.inl hb
    63	  · right
    64	    have hval_ne : b.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_ne_zero b).mpr hb
    65	    have hval_lt : b.val < 2 := ZMod.val_lt b
    66	    have hval : b.val = 1 := by omega
    67	    exact (ZMod.val_eq_one (by omega) b).mp hval
    68	
    69	/-- In characteristic two, the standard additive character is the sign
    70	character used by the binary Pauli definitions. -/
    71	theorem phaseSign_eq_ffChar (t : ZMod 2) :
    72	    phaseSign t = ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2) t := by
    73	  by_cases ht : t = 0
    74	  · subst t
    75	    rw [phaseSign, if_pos rfl]
    76	    exact (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2)).map_zero_eq_one.symm
    77	  · have hval : t.val = 1 := by
    78	      have hval_ne : t.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_ne_zero t).mpr ht
    79	      have hval_lt : t.val < 2 := ZMod.val_lt t
    80	      omega
    81	    have ht_one : t = 1 := (ZMod.val_eq_one (by omega) t).mp hval
    82	    subst t
    83	    rw [phaseSign, if_neg one_ne_zero]
    84	    change (-1 : ℂ) = ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2) ((1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2)
    85	    rw [ZMod.stdAddChar_coe]
    86	    convert Complex.exp_pi_mul_I.symm using 1
    87	    all_goals ring_nf

    89	/-- The binary sign character carries a sum to the product of the two signs.
    90	This is the character property underlying blueprint
    91	`def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
    92	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`. -/
    93	theorem phaseSign_add (s t : ZMod 2) :
    94	    phaseSign (s + t) = phaseSign s * phaseSign t := by
    95	  rw [phaseSign_eq_ffChar, phaseSign_eq_ffChar, phaseSign_eq_ffChar]
    96	  exact (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2)).map_add_eq_mul s t
    97	
    98	/-- The binary sign character takes real values, so conjugation fixes it. It is
    99	used by the observable expansions of blueprint
   100	`def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
   101	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`. -/
   102	theorem star_phaseSign (t : ZMod 2) : star (phaseSign t) = phaseSign t := by
   103	  by_cases ht : t = 0 <;> simp [phaseSign, ht]
   104	
   105	/-- The binary sign character squares to one, since the binary field has
   106	characteristic two. This is the eigenvalue property used by the observables of
   107	blueprint `def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
   108	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`. -/
   109	theorem phaseSign_mul_self (t : ZMod 2) : phaseSign t * phaseSign t = 1 := by
   110	  rw [← phaseSign_add]
   111	  have hzero : t + t = 0 := by
   112	    rcases zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one t with ht | ht <;> subst ht <;> decide
   113	  rw [hzero, phaseSign, if_pos rfl]
   114	
   115	/-- The binary sign character sends sums to products. -/
   116	theorem phaseSign_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → ZMod 2) :
   117	    phaseSign (∑ i, f i) = ∏ i, phaseSign (f i) := by
   118	  classical
   119	  induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
   120	  | empty => simp [phaseSign]
   121	  | @insert i s hi ih =>
   122	      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.prod_insert hi, phaseSign_add, ih]
   123

   125	/-- The product of the coordinate phases is the phase of the trace pairing. -/
   126	theorem prod_phaseSign_binTrace_dotProduct {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
   127	    (u v : ι → K) :
   128	    ∏ i, phaseSign (binTrace K (u i * v i)) =
   129	      phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) := by
   130	  rw [← phaseSign_sum]
   131	  congr 2
   132	  simp [dotProduct]

   134	/-- The complex amplitude `(√n)⁻¹` normalizing a uniform superposition over `n`
   135	basis vectors squares to `n⁻¹`.
   136	
   137	This formalization-only normalization identity supports the Pauli normalizer
   138	of blueprint `def:EPR`, paper origin
   139	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:908-950`, and the seed-fiber and
   140	correlated-ancilla amplitudes of the direct low-degree transport. -/
   141	theorem inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_self (n : ℕ) :
   142	    (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ =
   143	      (n : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
   144	  calc
   145	    (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ =
   146	        ((Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
   147	      rw [pow_two, mul_inv_rev]
   148	    _ = ((n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
   149	      rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
   150	    _ = (n : ℂ)⁻¹ := by norm_num
   151	
   152	/-- Conjugated form of `inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_self`: the normalizing amplitude
   153	`(√n)⁻¹` is real, so pairing it with its conjugate again gives `n⁻¹`.  This
   154	formalization-only auxiliary is the form in which the identity occurs in Born
   155	amplitudes, where the bra side carries the conjugate. -/
   156	theorem inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_conj (n : ℕ) :
   157	    (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
   158	        (starRingEnd ℂ) (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ =
   159	      (n : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
   160	  rw [show (starRingEnd ℂ) (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ =
   161	      (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ by simp]
   162	  exact inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_self n

   175	private theorem phaseSign_binTrace_dotProduct_add {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
   176	    (u v w : ι → K) :
   177	    phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) *
   178	        phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u w)) =

   184	omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] in
   185	private theorem add_add_eq_zero_iff_eq_add {ι : Type*} (a x y : ι → K) :
   186	    a + (x + y) = 0 ↔ x = y + a := by
   187	  letI : CharP K 2 :=
   188	    (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
   189	  constructor
   190	  · intro h
   191	    funext i
   192	    have hi : a i + (x i + y i) = 0 := by
   193	      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun h i
   194	    have hax : a i + x i = y i := (CharTwo.add_eq_zero).mp (by
   195	      simpa only [add_assoc] using hi)
   196	    calc
   197	      x i = a i + (a i + x i) := (CharTwo.add_cancel_left (a i) (x i)).symm
   198	      _ = a i + y i := by rw [hax]
   199	      _ = y i + a i := add_comm _ _
   200	  · intro h
   201	    funext i
   202	    have hxi : x i = y i + a i := by
   203	      simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using congrFun h i
   204	    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, hxi]
   205	    calc
   206	      a i + (y i + a i + y i) = (a i + a i) + (y i + y i) := by abel
   207	      _ = 0 := by rw [CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, zero_add]

   209	private theorem expect_phaseSign_dotProduct {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
   210	    [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → K) :
   211	    𝔼 u : (ι → K), phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) =
   212	      if v = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
   213	  let eι : ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι) := Fintype.equivFin ι
   214	  let reindex : (ι → K) ≃ (Fin (Fintype.card ι) → K) :=
   215	    { toFun := fun u j => u (eι.symm j)
   216	      invFun := fun u i => u (eι i)
   217	      left_inv := fun u => by
   218	        funext i
   219	        simp
   220	      right_inv := fun u => by
   221	        funext j
   222	        simp }
   223	  let v' : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → K := reindex v
   224	  calc
   225	    𝔼 u : (ι → K), phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) =
   226	        𝔼 u : (Fin (Fintype.card ι) → K),
   227	          phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v')) := by
   228	      refine Finset.expect_equiv reindex (by simp) ?_
   229	      intro u _
   230	      congr 3
   231	      simpa [reindex, v', Function.comp_def] using
   232	        (comp_equiv_dotProduct_comp_equiv u v eι.symm).symm
   233	    _ = 𝔼 u : (Fin (Fintype.card ι) → K),
   234	        ffVecChar (p := 2) (F := K) v' u := by
   235	      apply Finset.expect_congr rfl
   236	      intro u _
   237	      simp only [ffVecChar_apply, ffChar_apply]
   238	      rw [phaseSign_eq_ffChar]
   239	      rfl
   240	    _ = if v' = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := fourier_fact_vector v'
   241	    _ = if v = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
   242	      have reindex_zero : reindex (0 : ι → K) = 0 := by
   243	        ext j
   244	        rfl
   245	      by_cases hv : v = 0
   246	      · subst v
   247	        rw [show v' = 0 by exact reindex_zero]
   248	        simp
   249	      · have hv' : v' ≠ 0 := by
   250	          intro hv'
   251	          apply hv
   252	          apply reindex.injective
   253	          rw [reindex_zero]
   254	          exact hv'
   255	        simp [hv, hv']

   257	private theorem sum_phaseSign_dotProduct {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
   258	    [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → K) :
   259	    ∑ u : ι → K, phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) =
   260	      if v = 0 then (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ) else 0 := by
   261	  rw [← Fintype.card_smul_expect, expect_phaseSign_dotProduct]
   262	  by_cases hv : v = 0 <;> simp [hv]

    44	/-- The coordinatewise tensor-entry presentation used by the Pauli observables. -/
    45	private def productMatrix {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    46	    (A : ι → Matrix κ κ ℂ) : Matrix (ι → κ) (ι → κ) ℂ :=
    47	  fun x y => ∏ i, A i (x i) (y i)

    49	/-- Matrix multiplication distributes over `productMatrix`. -/
    50	private theorem productMatrix_mul {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    51	    [Fintype κ]
    52	    (A B : ι → Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    53	    (productMatrix A * productMatrix B : Matrix (ι → κ) (ι → κ) ℂ) =
    54	      productMatrix (fun i => A i * B i) := by
    55	  classical
    56	  ext x y
    57	  simpa only [productMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.prod_mul_distrib] using
    58	    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun i z => A i (x i) z * B i z (y i))).symm

    76	/-- The generalized Pauli observable with zero label is the identity. -/

   399	/-- The orthogonal projection of an enlarged local space onto its ground slice,
   400	namely the inflation of the identity.  Formalization-only support for the
   401	transfer step of blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity`. -/
   402	def groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

   407	theorem naimarkInflation_mul {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   408	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
   409	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M * naimarkInflation (α := α) N =
   410	      naimarkInflation (α := α) (M * N) := by
   411	  ext p q
   412	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
   413	    Fintype.sum_option]
   414	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]

   418	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   419	    (naimarkInflation (α := α) M)ᴴ = naimarkInflation (α := α) Mᴴ := by

   523	/-! ## Leakage out of the ground slice is bounded by the intertwining defect -/
   524	
   525	/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
   526	dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
   527	right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
   528	This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
   529	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/
   530	theorem norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   531	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   532	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   533	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   534	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   535	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   536	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   537	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   538	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   539	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   540	    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
   541	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   542	    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   543	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   544	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   545	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)
   546	  have hsplit : heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P)
   547	      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
   548	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   549	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
   550	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   551	      Matrix.mul_one]
   552	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1) ψ' =
   553	      applyOperatorToState L
   554	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ') := by
   555	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   556	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' =
   557	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' +
   558	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' := by
   559	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   560	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron 1 Q), hcomm,
   561	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   562	  rw [key]
   563	  exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _

   565	/-- The leakage of a right-placed operator `Q` out of the ground slice on the
   566	dilated state is at most its intertwining defect against any left-placed
   567	operator. -/
   568	theorem norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   569	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   570	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   571	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   572	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
   573	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   574	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   575	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   576	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   577	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   578	    heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α)
   579	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   580	    applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   581	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   582	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor
   583	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub)
   584	  have hsplit : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
   585	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q) = L * heteroKron 1 Q := by
   586	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   587	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron P 1 = heteroKron P 1 * L := by
   588	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   589	      Matrix.mul_one]
   590	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q)) ψ' =
   591	      applyOperatorToState L
   592	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ') := by
   593	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   594	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   595	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' +
   596	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   597	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   598	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron P 1), hcomm,
   599	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   600	  have hneg : -applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   601	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   602	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   603	  rw [key]
   604	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState L
   605	          (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ')‖ ≤
   606	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ'‖ :=
   607	        norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   608	    _ = ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ'‖ := by
   609	        rw [← hneg, norm_neg]
